inputs.help: Your installed copy of Serious Sam Classic: The Second Encounter from Steam or GOG. qgp copies its .gro files.

inputs.label: Serious Sam Classic: The First Encounter (optional)
inputs.help: Your installed copy of Serious Sam Classic: The First Encounter from Steam or GOG. qgp copies its .gro files.

stores.installDir: Serious Sam Classic The First Encounter

steps.why: The guide has the user grant All files access on the first launch.
The first launch creates the game folders and then closes.

steps.text: Open QuestSam from Library > Unknown Sources. If it asks for All files access, allow it. Choose your campaign and play.

notes: Uncertain. The guide says TFE and/or TSE, but the payload counts the game as installed only with SE1_00.gro (a TSE file), so TSE is required here and TFE optional. Whether TFE and TSE .gro files can share one folder is not stated; the repository's push_quest_data scripts push both to Android/data/.../files. The guide copies to the legacy /sdcard/questsam/ instead; the payload prefers Android/data. 1_00.gro as the TFE detect file comes from the guide's example list. Steam app IDs are not given. tag ^b\d+$ skips the pico-test release.
